findings.title: Security group allows unrestricted ingress to administrative ports
findings.description: SSH (22), RDP (3389) or WinRM (5985/5986) is reachable from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0. Any host on the Internet can attempt to authenticate to the instance.
findings.evidence: Solutions/CloudFormationEndpointSignals/cfn-endpoint-creationpolicy.yaml:242 — ports 22-22/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0
findings.severity_justification: Direct and immediate loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT I).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Architecture — Mission Owner network boundary protection (CAP/VDSS); Mission Owner SRG SRG-OS-000480-CLD-000030 (restrict inbound/outbound traffic flow)
findings.recommended_remediation: Replace the open CIDR with a parameterized Government CIDR (AllowedPattern that rejects /0), or remove the rule and use Systems Manager Session Manager / a bastion behind the CAP.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT I: 30 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.title: Database storage is not encrypted at rest
findings.description: The database resource does not set storage encryption to true. Mission data, automated backups and snapshots are stored in clear text. The Mission Owner SRG rates encryption of DoD data in cloud storage as High.
findings.evidence: NeptuneDB/Neptune.yaml:311 — Properties.StorageEncrypted resolves to [False]
findings.severity_justification: Direct and immediate loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT I).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Security Requirements — DoD Policy Regarding Security Controls (FedRAMP+ SC-28); Mission Owner SRG SRG-OS-000404-CLD-002720 (encrypt DoD files in cloud storage)
findings.recommended_remediation: Set StorageEncrypted: true (Encrypted: true for Redshift) and supply KmsKeyId with a customer-managed key. Encryption is set at creation; existing instances need a snapshot-copy migration.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT I: 30 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.title: S3 bucket does not block public access
findings.description: PublicAccessBlockConfiguration is absent or does not set all four settings to true. A later ACL or policy change can expose the bucket.

findings.severity_justification: Potential loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT II).

findings.recommended_remediation: Add PublicAccessBlockConfiguration with BlockPublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, IgnorePublicAcls and RestrictPublicBuckets all true.

findings.evidence: CloudFormation/MacrosExamples/DatetimeNow/datetimenow_example.yaml:7 — PublicAccessBlockConfiguration is absent
findings.severity_justification: Potential loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT II).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Architecture — Mission Owner network boundary protection (CAP/VDSS); Mission Owner SRG SRG-OS-000480-CLD-000030 (restrict inbound/outbound traffic flow)
findings.recommended_remediation: Add PublicAccessBlockConfiguration with BlockPublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, IgnorePublicAcls and RestrictPublicBuckets all true.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT II: 90 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.description: SSH (22), RDP (3389) or WinRM (5985/5986) is reachable from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0. Any host on the Internet can attempt to authenticate to the instance.
findings.evidence: EC2/ec2_with_waitcondition_template.yaml:243 — ports 22-22/tcp from parameter SSHLocation whose Default is 0.0.0.0/0
findings.severity_justification: Potential loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT II).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Architecture — Mission Owner network boundary protection (CAP/VDSS); Mission Owner SRG SRG-OS-000480-CLD-000030 (restrict inbound/outbound traffic flow)
findings.recommended_remediation: Replace the open CIDR with a parameterized Government CIDR (AllowedPattern that rejects /0), or remove the rule and use Systems Manager Session Manager / a bastion behind the CAP.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT II: 90 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.title: Edge endpoint allows TLS below 1.2 or clear-text viewers
findings.description: API Gateway custom domain SecurityPolicy is not TLS_1_2, CloudFront allows HTTP viewers or a MinimumProtocolVersion below TLSv1.2, OpenSearch does not enforce HTTPS with a TLS 1.2 policy, or ElastiCache does not enable in-transit encryption.
findings.evidence: Solutions/GitLab/GitLabServer-pkg.yaml:385 — DefaultCacheBehavior.ViewerProtocolPolicy=allow-all
findings.severity_justification: Potential loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT II).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Security Requirements — DoD Policy Regarding Security Controls (FedRAMP+ SC-8/SC-13, FIPS 140 validated cryptography)
findings.recommended_remediation: Set SecurityPolicy: TLS_1_2; ViewerProtocolPolicy redirect-to-https/https-only with MinimumProtocolVersion TLSv1.2_2021; DomainEndpointOptions EnforceHTTPS with Policy-Min-TLS-1-2; TransitEncryptionEnabled: true.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT II: 90 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.title: Load balancer listener accepts clear-text traffic
findings.description: The listener uses HTTP (or a TCP/HTTP Classic ELB listener) and does not redirect to HTTPS. Data between clients and the load balancer is not encrypted.
findings.evidence: ECS/EC2LaunchType/clusters/private-vpc.yaml:567 — Protocol=HTTP without HTTPS redirect
findings.severity_justification: Potential loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT II).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Security Requirements — DoD Policy Regarding Security Controls (FedRAMP+ SC-8/SC-13, FIPS 140 validated cryptography)
findings.recommended_remediation: Use Protocol: HTTPS/TLS with an ACM certificate and SslPolicy ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06; keep a port-80 listener only as a redirect to HTTPS.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT II: 90 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.title: Security group allows unrestricted ingress on an application port
findings.description: A non-administrative port is open to 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0. This is expected for a public web tier behind the Cloud Access Point, but each rule needs Government confirmation of intent.

findings.severity_justification: Potential loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT II).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Architecture — Mission Owner network boundary protection (CAP/VDSS); Mission Owner SRG SRG-OS-000480-CLD-000030 (restrict inbound/outbound traffic flow)

findings.title: Load balancer listener accepts clear-text traffic
findings.description: The listener uses HTTP (or a TCP/HTTP Classic ELB listener) and does not redirect to HTTPS. Data between clients and the load balancer is not encrypted.
findings.evidence: AutoScaling/AutoScalingRollingUpdates.yaml:360 — Listeners[0].Protocol=HTTP (clear text)
findings.severity_justification: Potential loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT II).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Security Requirements — DoD Policy Regarding Security Controls (FedRAMP+ SC-8/SC-13, FIPS 140 validated cryptography)
findings.recommended_remediation: Use Protocol: HTTPS/TLS with an ACM certificate and SslPolicy ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06; keep a port-80 listener only as a redirect to HTTPS.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT II: 90 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.title: EBS volume is not encrypted
findings.description: An EBS volume or block device mapping does not set Encrypted: true. Data on the volume and its snapshots is unprotected unless account-level default encryption is enabled.
findings.evidence: Config/Config.yaml:41 — Properties.Encrypted is absent
findings.severity_justification: Potential loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT II).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Security Requirements — DoD Policy Regarding Security Controls (FedRAMP+ SC-28); Mission Owner SRG SRG-OS-000404-CLD-002720 (encrypt DoD files in cloud storage)
findings.recommended_remediation: Set Encrypted: true (and KmsKeyId) on every AWS::EC2::Volume and on each BlockDeviceMappings[].Ebs entry; enable EBS default encryption in the account as a backstop.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT II: 90 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.title: Edge endpoint allows TLS below 1.2 or clear-text viewers
findings.description: API Gateway custom domain SecurityPolicy is not TLS_1_2, CloudFront allows HTTP viewers or a MinimumProtocolVersion below TLSv1.2, OpenSearch does not enforce HTTPS with a TLS 1.2 policy, or ElastiCache does not enable in-transit encryption.
findings.evidence: RainModules/static-site.yml:27 — ViewerCertificate MinimumProtocolVersion=default (TLSv1 with the CloudFront default certificate)
findings.severity_justification: Potential loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT II).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Security Requirements — DoD Policy Regarding Security Controls (FedRAMP+ SC-8/SC-13, FIPS 140 validated cryptography)
findings.recommended_remediation: Set SecurityPolicy: TLS_1_2; ViewerProtocolPolicy redirect-to-https/https-only with MinimumProtocolVersion TLSv1.2_2021; DomainEndpointOptions EnforceHTTPS with Policy-Min-TLS-1-2; TransitEncryptionEnabled: true.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT II: 90 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.title: S3 bucket does not declare server-side encryption
findings.description: The bucket has no BucketEncryption block. Encryption then depends on the account default (SSE-S3) and the baseline cannot show that data at rest is protected with an approved key.
findings.evidence: CloudFormation/MacrosExamples/Count/test.yaml:16 — Properties.BucketEncryption is absent
findings.severity_justification: Potential loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT II).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Security Requirements — DoD Policy Regarding Security Controls (FedRAMP+ SC-28); Mission Owner SRG SRG-OS-000404-CLD-002720 (encrypt DoD files in cloud storage)
findings.recommended_remediation: Add BucketEncryption with ServerSideEncryptionByDefault using aws:kms and a customer-managed key; set BucketKeyEnabled: true.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT II: 90 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.evidence: CloudFormation/MacrosExamples/StringFunctions/string_example.yaml:12 — Properties.BucketEncryption is absent
findings.severity_justification: Potential loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT II).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Security Requirements — DoD Policy Regarding Security Controls (FedRAMP+ SC-28); Mission Owner SRG SRG-OS-000404-CLD-002720 (encrypt DoD files in cloud storage)
findings.recommended_remediation: Add BucketEncryption with ServerSideEncryptionByDefault using aws:kms and a customer-managed key; set BucketKeyEnabled: true.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT II: 90 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.title: EBS volume is not encrypted
findings.description: An EBS volume or block device mapping does not set Encrypted: true. Data on the volume and its snapshots is unprotected unless account-level default encryption is enabled.
findings.evidence: EC2/InstanceWithCfnInit.yaml:62 — BlockDeviceMappings[0].Ebs.Encrypted is not true
findings.severity_justification: Potential loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT II).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Security Requirements — DoD Policy Regarding Security Controls (FedRAMP+ SC-28); Mission Owner SRG SRG-OS-000404-CLD-002720 (encrypt DoD files in cloud storage)
findings.recommended_remediation: Set Encrypted: true (and KmsKeyId) on every AWS::EC2::Volume and on each BlockDeviceMappings[].Ebs entry; enable EBS default encryption in the account as a backstop.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT II: 90 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.title: RDS database does not enforce TLS connections (rds.force_ssl / require_secure_transport)
findings.description: The database has no parameter group in the template that sets rds.force_ssl=1 (PostgreSQL/SQL Server) or require_secure_transport=ON (MySQL/MariaDB). Clients may connect without TLS.
findings.evidence: RDS/RDS_MySQL_With_Read_Replica.yaml:100 — no DBParameterGroupName
findings.severity_justification: Potential loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT II).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Security Requirements — DoD Policy Regarding Security Controls (FedRAMP+ SC-8/SC-13, FIPS 140 validated cryptography)
findings.recommended_remediation: Create an AWS::RDS::DBParameterGroup/DBClusterParameterGroup that forces TLS and reference it from the database resource.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT II: 90 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.recommended_remediation: Attach an AWS::S3::BucketPolicy with a Deny statement for s3:* on the bucket and its objects with Condition Bool aws:SecureTransport: false.

findings.title: IAM policy uses service-level wildcard actions
findings.description: An Allow statement grants service:* (for example s3:* or ec2:*). The principal receives every current and future action for the service, far beyond what the workload needs.
findings.evidence: Solutions/CloudFormationEndpointSignals/cfn-endpoint-creationpolicy.yaml:215 — Policies[0]: cloudformation:*
findings.severity_justification: Potential loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT II).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Identification, Authentication and Access Control; Mission Owner SRG SRG-OS-000001-CLD-000010 (privileged accounts configured for least privilege)
findings.recommended_remediation: Replace service:* with the specific actions the workload calls; use IAM Access Analyzer policy generation from CloudTrail to derive the list.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT II: 90 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.evidence: Solutions/CloudFrontCustomOriginLambda@Edge/CloudFront.yaml:572 — SslPolicy=ELBSecurityPolicy-FS-2018-06
findings.severity_justification: Potential loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT II).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Security Requirements — DoD Policy Regarding Security Controls (FedRAMP+ SC-8/SC-13, FIPS 140 validated cryptography)
findings.recommended_remediation: Set SslPolicy: ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06 (or another TLS 1.2-minimum policy).

findings.title: IAM policy uses service-level wildcard actions
findings.description: An Allow statement grants service:* (for example s3:* or ec2:*). The principal receives every current and future action for the service, far beyond what the workload needs.
findings.evidence: Config/Config.yaml:212 — Policies[0]: logs:*
findings.severity_justification: Potential loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT II).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Identification, Authentication and Access Control; Mission Owner SRG SRG-OS-000001-CLD-000010 (privileged accounts configured for least privilege)
findings.recommended_remediation: Replace service:* with the specific actions the workload calls; use IAM Access Analyzer policy generation from CloudTrail to derive the list.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT II: 90 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.recommended_remediation: Replace service:* with the specific actions the workload calls; use IAM Access Analyzer policy generation from CloudTrail to derive the list.

findings.severity_justification: Potential loss of confidentiality, integrity or availability (DISA CAT II).

findings.recommended_remediation: Add MetadataOptions: {HttpTokens: required, HttpEndpoint: enabled, HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1} to the instance, launch template or launch configuration.

findings.evidence: CloudFormation/MacrosExamples/Explode/test.yaml:35 — Properties.LoggingConfiguration is absent
findings.severity_justification: Degrades protection measures or defense in depth (DISA CAT III).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Computer Network Defense and Incident Response — Continuous Monitoring; Mission Owner SRG SRG-OS-000342-CLD-000020 (centralized logging)
findings.recommended_remediation: Add LoggingConfiguration pointing at a dedicated, encrypted log bucket, or enable CloudTrail data events for the bucket.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT III: 180 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.title: S3 bucket encryption does not use a customer-managed KMS key
findings.description: Server-side encryption is enabled but uses SSE-S3 or an AWS-managed key. The Government cannot control key policy, rotation or revocation.
findings.evidence: CloudFormation/StackSets/common-resources-pkg.json:80 — SSEAlgorithm=AES256 without KMSMasterKeyID
findings.severity_justification: Degrades protection measures or defense in depth (DISA CAT III).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Security Requirements — DoD Policy Regarding Security Controls (FedRAMP+ SC-28); Mission Owner SRG SRG-OS-000404-CLD-002720 (encrypt DoD files in cloud storage)
findings.recommended_remediation: Set SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms and KMSMasterKeyID to a customer-managed key with a restrictive key policy.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT III: 180 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.description: The queue sets neither KmsMasterKeyId nor SqsManagedSseEnabled. Protection depends on the service default (SSE-SQS) and the Government cannot control the key.
findings.evidence: CloudFormation/StackSets/common-resources.yaml:22 — KmsMasterKeyId and SqsManagedSseEnabled are absent
findings.severity_justification: Degrades protection measures or defense in depth (DISA CAT III).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Security Requirements — DoD Policy Regarding Security Controls (FedRAMP+ SC-28); Mission Owner SRG SRG-OS-000404-CLD-002720 (encrypt DoD files in cloud storage)
findings.recommended_remediation: Set KmsMasterKeyId to a customer-managed key (or at minimum SqsManagedSseEnabled: true).
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT III: 180 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.title: CloudWatch log group has no retention period

findings.severity_justification: Degrades protection measures or defense in depth (DISA CAT III).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Computer Network Defense and Incident Response — Continuous Monitoring; Mission Owner SRG SRG-OS-000342-CLD-000020 (centralized logging)
findings.recommended_remediation: Set RetentionInDays to the Government-approved retention period (for example 365 or 400 days) or archive to S3 with lifecycle rules.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT III: 180 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.title: Stateful resource has no backup or point-in-time recovery configuration
findings.description: BackupRetentionPeriod is absent or 0 (RDS), PointInTimeRecoverySpecification is not enabled (DynamoDB), BackupPolicy is not ENABLED (EFS) or VersioningConfiguration is not Enabled (S3). Data cannot be restored after corruption or deletion.
findings.evidence: EFS/EFSAccessPoint.yaml:42 — BackupPolicy.Status is not ENABLED
findings.severity_justification: Degrades protection measures or defense in depth (DISA CAT III).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Data Recovery and Destruction (CP-9 backup and recovery of Mission Owner data)
findings.recommended_remediation: Set BackupRetentionPeriod >= 7 with a PreferredBackupWindow; enable PointInTimeRecovery; set BackupPolicy Status ENABLED; enable S3 versioning with lifecycle rules.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT III: 180 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.title: Stateful resource lacks deletion protection or a Retain deletion policy
findings.description: DeletionProtection is not true and the resource has no DeletionPolicy of Retain or Snapshot. A stack delete or a template error removes the data.
findings.evidence: EFS/EFSAccessPoint.yaml:42 — DeletionPolicy=None; no deletion protection
findings.severity_justification: Degrades protection measures or defense in depth (DISA CAT III).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Data Recovery and Destruction (CP-9 backup and recovery of Mission Owner data)
findings.recommended_remediation: Set DeletionProtection: true (RDS) / DeletionProtectionEnabled: true (DynamoDB) and DeletionPolicy: Retain or Snapshot with UpdateReplacePolicy on the resource.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT III: 180 days from Government acceptance of this report

findings.title: Encrypted resource relies on an AWS-managed key instead of a customer-managed key
findings.description: Encryption is enabled but no KmsKeyId is set, so the service default AWS-managed key is used. Key policy, rotation and cross-account use cannot be controlled.
findings.evidence: EFS/EFSAccessPoint.yaml:44 — Encrypted is true but KmsKeyId is absent
findings.severity_justification: Degrades protection measures or defense in depth (DISA CAT III).
findings.dod_cloud_srg_area: Security Requirements — DoD Policy Regarding Security Controls (FedRAMP+ SC-28); Mission Owner SRG SRG-OS-000404-CLD-002720 (encrypt DoD files in cloud storage)
findings.recommended_remediation: Set KmsKeyId to a customer-managed key created in the template or supplied as a parameter.
findings.target_date: TBD — CAT III: 180 days from Government acceptance of this report
